description: Pull stock data from Yahoo Finance for one or more tickers. Toggle which sections to include.

concurrency.description: Number of tickers fetched in parallel. Each fetch is mostly idle waiting on Yahoo, so concurrency speeds up bulk runs significantly. Higher values may trigger Yahoo rate-limits.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

endDate.description: Latest date for historical OHLCV data. Optional — default is today.
endDate.title: History end date (YYYY-MM-DD)

includeAnalystPriceTargets.description: Include analyst price target summary (current / high / low / mean / median).
includeAnalystPriceTargets.title: Include analyst price targets

includeEarningsCalendar.description: Include upcoming earnings/dividend dates + analyst earnings/revenue estimates.
includeEarningsCalendar.title: Include earnings calendar

includeEarningsHistory.description: Include the last 4 quarters of earnings: actual EPS, estimate, surprise amount, and surprise percent.
includeEarningsHistory.title: Include earnings history

includeFinancials.description: Include income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement (annual).
includeFinancials.title: Include financials

includeHistory.description: Include daily OHLCV history (open / high / low / close / volume) in each record.
includeHistory.title: Include OHLCV history

includeHolders.description: Include major / institutional / mutual-fund holder summaries.
includeHolders.title: Include holders

includeInsiderTransactions.description: Include the 25 most-recent insider transactions (officers / directors / 10%-owners).
includeInsiderTransactions.title: Include insider transactions

includeNews.description: Include latest news headlines linked to the ticker.
includeNews.title: Include news

includeOptions.description: Include the next-expiration options chain (calls + puts) when listed. Capped at first 50 strikes per side to keep dataset compact.
includeOptions.title: Include options chain

includeQuarterlyFinancials.description: Include quarterly income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow (last ~5 quarters). Takes effect only when `includeFinancials` is also on.
includeQuarterlyFinancials.title: Include quarterly financials

includeRecommendations.description: Include analyst recommendation breakdown (strongBuy / buy / hold / sell / strongSell).
includeRecommendations.title: Include analyst recommendations

includeSustainability.description: Include ESG / sustainability scores when Yahoo publishes them (sparse coverage; many tickers return empty).
includeSustainability.title: Include ESG / sustainability scores

startDate.description: Earliest date for historical OHLCV data. Optional — default is 30 days before today.
startDate.title: History start date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tickers.description: One or more stock ticker symbols (e.g. `AAPL`, `MSFT`, `BRK-B`). Supports US, ETFs, ADRs, foreign tickers with suffix (e.g. `BABA`, `TSM`, `BP.L`).
tickers.title: Tickers

title: Yahoo Finance Scraper Input
